verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage publishes a per-endpoint API reference under /reference/, including monitoring, exports, audit, roles and transactions. It also offers a first-party Postman collection and a downloadable OpenAPI schema, which a probe confirmed parses as OpenAPI 3.0.3. The Postman collection gives runnable request examples, but nothing shows the reference itself is interactive. missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser 'try it' console on the reference pages, runnable code samples embedded in the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
